ci_method: Wilson score 95% (conservative binomial approximation) as primary; exact hypergeometric equal-tailed 95% as finite-population sensitivity field on each band end
census_note: sample (150) < eligible pool (698); result is an SRS sub-sample, not a full-pool census
metric_scope: detector_clean_miss_prevalence is the proportion of the detector-clean population that a single LLM judge flags as a miss, estimated on a pooled SRS. It is NOT recall or a false-negative rate: it is a prevalence over the detector's own no-risk output, not a sensitivity against a ground-truth leak set. The headline is a missingness band over the full n (optimistic misses=k, pessimistic misses=k+m); the complete-case point is descriptive only. m permanent-invalid judgments are missing data, never 'no miss'.
